title: Fuji's power electronics contributes to energy savings and the best ride-comfort to Japanese bullet train, Shinkansen
lineage: Original publisher's text inspected. Saved notes paraphrase the identified passages.

passages.locator: Reducing power consumption by making the main converter inverter 70% lighter
passages.note: A participating supplier explains the transition from forced-air blowers to natural cooling via train-induced airflow as semiconductors' power loss fell. It discusses the progress to the N700S converter.

passages.locator: Unshakeable teamwork across departments and production bases
passages.note: Fuji Electric attests its participation in development of the N700S converter using silicon carbide devices.
